title: Banking
description: Proactive loan offer and finding documents (transactions with receipts). Italian customers.
notes:
Two use cases on one customer base.

1) Proactive loan offer: the assistant spots customers whose 3-month average balance is below 300 EUR (rule R-LOWBAL) and offers a personal loan of 5,000-10,000 EUR over 24 or 36 months at 6% APR. Elena Bianchi (C001, +39 347 000 0301) is the main case: average 212.40 EUR, eligible up to 10,000 EUR, prefers phone. Chiara Esposito (C003) and Francesca Romano (C005) are below the threshold but must NOT get an offer (identity check pending / existing loan). Alessandro Conti (C004) is just above the threshold. Marco Rossi (C002) is healthy and has an example loan request.

2) Finding documents: every transaction carries its own receipt (doc_id, doc_category, doc_title, doc_url). Rule R-DOCLINKS: up to 5 links go into the chat; above that the assistant sends the customer's documents_page_url. 29 transactions, built to test how many results come back:
- 1 result: Alessandro, the notary last month (Studio Notarile Bruno); Marco, the car deposit last month (Autosalone Bellini).
- 2 to 5 results: Alessandro, the electrician last month: 3 transfers, 1,200 EUR in total. A 4th, made today (pending), must not count as last month.
- more than 5 results: Alessandro, 7 renovation transfers last year; Elena, rent: one payment a month for 8 months (the 3 most recent give 3 results, all of them 8).
- older than 6 months: Alessandro's renovation (last year) and F24 / insurance; Elena's rent 7 and 8 months ago; Marco's tuition 9 months ago.
Messy payee names on purpose: 'G. Ferrari' and 'Ferari Giorgio' (the electrician), 'VITALE MARCO PIASTRELLE' and 'M. Vitale', 'Costa Ed. Srl', 'Greco P. Idraulica', 'Tinteggiature Rosi'; no name at all (only in the causale): the window fitter 'Serramenti Torino snc' and one rent payment ('Imm. Duomo'); 'IMMOB. DUOMO SRL' and 'Immobiliare Duomo' for the landlord. The beneficiary IBAN stays the same, so it can identify the payee when the name does not. Dates are relative to the day the dataset is loaded, so reload it to keep 'last month' and 'last year' true.
